findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects are not required to be encrypted at rest with a specified encryption method or key.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving exported ledger objects without enforced encryption at rest.
The bucket has versioning and access logging but no default server-side encryption rule; uploaded model artifacts are not required to be encrypted at rest.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, so stored runbooks are not protected by an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest policy.
